_doc:
Design OPTIONS for the user to pick (user 2026-11-09: the user picks every character design from an option sheet; nothing else is
drawn for these characters until the pick is relayed). Writes this demo's project/web_prompts.json option jobs (opt_<char>_<a|b|c>),
rendered with python3 tools/openai/images.py <demo> <jobs…> --quality medium (cheap: options only; the picked design is redrawn at
high quality as the base pose later). Same file in Demo46–50; the table for this folder is chosen by the folder name.
Run: python3 scripts/design_options.py

opt_hinata_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the STYLE and CHARACTER reference (image 2: closer face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern anime illustration, thin coloured lineart, soft cel shading with one soft-edged shadow layer, romantic otome-game card quality, not glossy, no bloom, not realistic, not 3D. Realistic adult proportions (7.5 heads). He is EXTREMELY handsome: idol-level beautiful face, clear jawline, long lashes, no stubble. Keep his FACE exactly as in images 1 and 2 (eye shape and colour, brows, nose, mouth) — the same man. Only clothes, hairstyle and fantasy features change. A storybook Western-fantasy world: no modern objects, no glasses, no earbuds.

Hinata: fluffy messy soft PINK hair with long bangs, warm amber eyes, a sweet face with a tiny fang in a sly smile, a small silver star stud earring. Identity: a little-devil BUTLER bound to the viewer by a contract — sweet in public, dark and teasing at the ear.

Outfit A: a neat black tailcoat butler uniform, white shirt, crimson cravat, white gloves; two small curved black horns in his pink hair, a pair of little black bat wings at his back, a thin devil tail with a heart tip.

Wide 16:9 character design sheet image, ONE character (or the named group) standing in the centre, full figure from head to toe inside the frame with margin, plain flat light-grey background (#d8d8d8), nothing else. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no UI.
